mails.subject: Re: Your approved funds release
mails.body:
Dear Friend,

> We are pleased to inform you that your compensation fund has been approved.

I am following up because I have not received your reply. The fund of 1,800,000 EUR is ready for transfer, but our legal department needs a refundable security deposit of 900 EUR to release it.
Please send the deposit by crypto transfer and confirm with your full name and phone number.
This offer is confidential and expires in 72 hours.

Victoria Ashdown
Crestfield Assets, Release Division
mails.justification: Advance-fee scam presented as a follow-up to a thread that never existed, asking for a deposit.

mails.subject: Brunch festival i weekenden - kom og vær med!
mails.body:
Hej alle sammen

Jeg skriver for at fortælle om Københavns Brunch Festival som afholdes d. 3. og 4. oktober på en stor plads i byen. Der kommer over 60 boder med alt fra pandekager til vegansk smørrebrød, og der er live musik begge dage.

Billetter koster 95 kr for voksne og børn under 12 kommer gratis ind. Hvis i booker 10 billetter eller mere får i 20 procent rabat, det kan være godt til en gruppe fra jeres kontorfælleskab.

Vi leder også efter virksomheder der vil have en stand eller sponsorere festivalen, priserne starter ved 4.500 kr.

Se programmet og køb billetter på koebenhavn-brunch-festival.example, det tager kun to minutter.

Jeg håber vi ses!! Del gerne mailen med dem i kender, så fylder vi pladsen helt op.

Hilsen Bo
Festivalarrangør
Sendt fra min telefon, undskyld evt. tastefejl
mails.justification: Mass festival marketing sent to many businesses, with no subscription or prior relationship.

mails.subject: Skræddersyet CRM til jeres fællesskab
mails.body:
Hej

Jeg ved det er lørdag aften, men jeg ville gerne skrive mens jeg tænkte på det. Datasmedjen bygger skræddersyede CRM-systemer til små virksomheder, og jeg tror vi kan spare jer mange timer.
Vi har et færdigt setup der passer til kontorfælleskaber, og vi kan have det oppe at køre på to uger.
Hvis i vil høre mere, så svar blot på denne mail, så sender jeg en kort præsentation.

Mvh Lars Brandt
Datasmedjen
mails.justification: Cold software sales pitch sent late on a Saturday by a company the space never contacted.

mails.subject: Guest post? 🙌
mails.body:
Hey there! 👋

Zara here from LinkJuice! I stumbled on your site yesterday and honestly loved the vibe 😍 Really great work on the space!

So here's the thing: we help sites like yours get seen on Google. 🚀 We could write you a few free guest posts (yes, FREE!) in exchange for a couple of links back to our clients. Win-win, right? 🙂

And if you'd like to go further, we've got really affordable packages for backlinks, so you can climb the rankings without the headache. 📈

We've done this for loads of blogs and the results are crazy good. Seriously, some of them doubled their visitors in 6 weeks! 🤯

If this sounds fun, just reply with "yes please" and I'll send over some topic ideas and a sample article! ✨

Or, if you prefer, we can hop on a super quick 10 min chat. Totally up to you! 😊

Talk soon,
Zara 💛
LinkJuice Outreach
mails.justification: Unsolicited guest-post and backlink offer from a stranger.

mails.subject: Your mailbox will be deactivated
mails.body:
Dear user,

Our system detected that your mailbox has exceeded its storage quota and that several login attempts were made from an unknown location.

To prevent your mailbox from being deactivated, you must verify your account within 12 hours. Accounts that are not verified will lose access to all emails, contacts and calendar entries.

Please follow these steps:
1. Click the link below
2. Enter your email address and current password
3. Confirm the code you receive by text message

Verification link: http://mailbox-verify-center.example/secure/login

If you do not complete this process, we will not be able to recover your data.

This is an automated message. Please do not reply.

Customer Security Team
Mailbox Verify Center
Reference: MV-88213-DK
mails.justification: Phishing claiming the mailbox will be deactivated, asking for the password and a text message code on a fake site.

mails.subject: Invitation officielle : Forum de l'Innovation Nordique 2026
mails.body:
Madame, Monsieur,

Nous avons le plaisir de vous convier à la sixième édition du Forum de l'Innovation Nordique, qui se tiendra à Copenhague les 12 et 13 novembre 2026.
Cet événement réunit des dirigeants, des investisseurs et des responsables de communautés autour des enjeux de la transformation numérique.
Les frais de participation s'élèvent à 420 EUR par personne. Les inscriptions sont ouvertes sur forum-innovation-nordique.example.
Nous vous prions de bien vouloir diffuser cette invitation auprès de vos membres.

Veuillez agréer, Madame, Monsieur, nos salutations distinguées.
La Direction des Événements
mails.justification: Mass conference marketing from an organiser the space never subscribed to.
